chunks: From him, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams) عليهما السلام, who said:
I asked him about the salat (prayer) on the day of al-Fitr and al-Adha, so he said: There is no salat (prayer) except with an Imam.

key_terms.إِمَامٍ: an Imam, whose presence is stated here as a condition for this prayer
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the ritual salat (prayer) being discussed here, specifically the Eid prayer
key_terms.الْأَضْحَى: Eid al-Adha, the festival of sacrifice

ai.seo_question: Is the Eid prayer valid or obligatory without an Imam according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Eid prayer of al-Fitr and al-Adha is not established except with an Imam. It is presented as a legal ruling concerning the condition for the validity or obligation of the Eid prayer within the Shia juridical framework.
